fichas.title: Lighting: illuminance, lighting layouts and floodlighting
fichas.summary: Reference page on estimating mean illuminance and connected lighting load, selecting correction factors by room height, area and surface reflectance, and calculating luminous flux for floodlighting. It illustrates interior and office lighting layouts, ceiling-grid fittings and light structures. The page also gives example luminance levels for buildings and reflectance values for common materials.
